assessment.governing_intent: Produce an offline, denied-network capstone proof for SF-REQ-039. It must exercise the canonical producer -> independent verifier -> rework/review/accept/closure lifecycle through the production composition and WorkerProvider path, with actual local Git custody and durable outcome correlation. Discriminating negative controls must show that missing, miscorrelated, wrong-candidate, custody, binding and verifier-independence violations hold or fail. It must make no live proof claim and must not implement or repair upstream capabilities.
implementation_unknowns: Whether the current WorkerOutcome can carry every observable the capstone must assert, such as role, attempt, candidate SHA and finding/receipt correlation. The text allows extending it only if revised Design Verification proves it necessary.
How the existing proof surfaces (tests/composition/test_offline_proof.py and the related test files) are structured, and where the FX-O fixture should be introduced or extended.

How to inject crash-before-output and progress-then-crash conditions, and how to establish conclusively-dead versus UNKNOWN ownership for AC-08 through the Deterministic Test Worker without scripted lifecycle transitions.
How to enforce and observe denied outbound network, including attempted-network refusal and a zero provider-call count, in the local harness.
How to apply and count exactly one discriminating negative control per material failure class, then restore canonical behavior and show it passes.
material_risks: Predecessor dependency is unmet: WO-220403 is UNMATERIALIZED. Proceeding now would either fail or tempt the producer to implement K1/K2 binding and correlation seams inside the capstone, violating the non-goals.

Scope tension from the founder amendment: AC-08 requires bounded deterministic recovery after conclusive death with a confirmed missing result. If no predecessor supplies that behavior, the capstone could only expose a defect, not satisfy the criterion. Ownership of that implementation should be confirmed when the hold lifts.
Risk of producing a scenario-written lifecycle or a mocked second lifecycle instead of exercising the production composition path.
Harness coupling: composition, execution coordination and invocation runtime tests interact, so repair of a failing negative control may span several areas.
Evidence obligations are extensive: immutable observation refs, negative-control application counts and separate verdicts. Incomplete retention could make an otherwise passing run unacceptable.
assessment.next_action: Hold this BIU in TASKS until WO-220403 is materialized, implemented and DONE with retained predecessor proof: K1 real WorkerProvider outcome/readback seam, K2 canonical role orchestration, and profile binding guards. Then confirm that WO-220101 and WO-220301 proof remains current at the pinned source revision. Confirm which node owns the AC-08 recovery behavior from the founder amendment. Finally, request a fresh Agent Ready assessment of the exact revision.
assessment.rationale: HOLD is the controlling condition because a necessary external prerequisite, the WO-220403 predecessor proof and capability, is explicitly unavailable. The capstone is defined as integration and verification over that capability and may not invent or repair it. Intent, ownership and acceptance are otherwise well specified, so CLARIFY would be inappropriate. The remaining uncertainties are engineering research. The work is one cohesive lifecycle proof with a single meaningful verdict, so SPLIT would fragment it without creating independent decision centers.
assessment.summary: The task text is detailed and internally coherent about intent, ownership boundaries, acceptance and proof policy. However, it states that predecessor WO-220403 is UNMATERIALIZED. That node supplies the K1/K2 predecessor proof this capstone integrates: profile constructors that refuse missing or miscorrelated role authority, custody or outcome binding before worker launch, and real-adapter correlated readback. The task's own Readiness section says it remains TASKS until every predecessor BIU is DONE. The work is cohesive integration and verification, not a split candidate. It is blocked on an unavailable prerequisite, not on unresolved owner intent. WO-220101 and WO-220301 are reported DONE; this gate has not verified that.
assessment.verification_assessment: Acceptance is observable and fits one independent verdict. It is a single end-to-end offline lifecycle proof with enumerated failure classes (AC-07, AC-08, custody, verifier independence, binding, correlation, judgment hold, single authorized effect, closure receipts). It has one discriminating negative control per class, named proof surfaces and an initial bounded pytest command. A fresh verifier can retrieve the exact published SHA and judge the whole capstone. That verdict is only meaningful once the WO-220403 seams exist. Otherwise the proof would fail for predecessor reasons or would require building upstream capability in this node, which the non-goals forbid.
